home.description: Turn documents into a typed world, compress it into finite Markov kernels, and forecast what happens next with explicit uncertainty.

world.name: World build
world.description: Upload documents, run the extraction task, and review the typed world graph. World entities and agent candidates are counted separately.

model.name: Model setup
model.description: Review the variable registry and the mechanisms, compile the model, and check its diagnostics and agent eligibility.

forecast.name: Forecast & simulate
forecast.description: Define scenarios with half-open interventions, run forecasts, and follow run progress.

report.name: Report
report.description: Read outcome distributions by horizon, baseline against intervention, NLL and Brier scores, and validation status. Absent calibration reads "missing", never a number.

interaction.name: Interaction
interaction.description: Ask what-if questions, inspect mechanisms, and explore rank and influence diagnostics.
